items.docs: **Deprecated**: Use `POST /v2/ai/openai/chat/completions` instead. Chat with a language model. This endpoint is consistent with the [OpenAI Chat Completions API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat) and may be used with the OpenAI JS or Python SDK.

**Deprecated**: Use `GET /v2/ai/openai/models` instead. This endpoint returns a list of Open Source and OpenAI models that are available for use.

**Note**: Model `id`'s will be in the form `{source}/{model_name}`. For example `openai/gpt-4` or `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1` consistent with HuggingFace naming conventions.

Generate a summary of a file's contents. 

 Supports the following text formats: 
- PDF, HTML, txt, json, csv

 Supports the following media formats (billed for both the transcription and summary): 
- flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm
- Up to 100 MB
